<!-- pr-reviewer: f7598d6edaf7133c5caa030ba3c7fc95f55b5c4f -->
**Verdict: Clean - ready to merge**

Independent review of the 0.14.0 release PR at head `f7598d6`. This was a read-only check: nothing was built or run.

- **Scope:** `git diff origin/main..release/v0.14.0` touches only release files: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md` and `RECOMMENDED.md`, plus the 13 deleted `docs/decisions/*.md` files. `docs/decisions/README.md` is still there. No source code or tests change.
- **Decisions:** all 13 deleted decision files appear under `## v0.14.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` in `RECOMMENDED.md`. Every line longer than 25 characters in each deleted file was found there (0 missing out of 446). `RECOMMENDED.md` only gains lines; none are removed.
- **CHANGELOG:** 42 new rows, all in the form `| hash | date | change (#N, PR #M) | 0.14.0 |`. Each row's hash is its PR's merge commit. That includes #235 (`3a0b564`), which reached main through #238 rather than as its own first-parent merge.
  - Every behaviour PR merged since v0.13.0 has exactly one row: no misses, no duplicates.
  - The 19 PRs without a row (#264, #254, #253, #250, #248, #245, #217, #205, #194, #193, #176, #149, #142, #137, #136, #134, #133, #132, #126) all say `Changelog: none`.
  - No row carries the `PR #M` placeholder. No `Unreleased` rows are left (the word only appears in the header prose).
- **Version:** the workspace `version = "0.14.0"`. All 9 crates (app, cl, geometry, kernel, motion, post, sim, tools, ui) use `version.workspace = true`, and `Cargo.lock` bumps all 9 entries from 0.13.0 to 0.14.0.
- **Closing keywords:** none in the PR body or in the branch's commit messages.
- **Mergeable:** `MERGEABLE`.

**Non-blocking nits**
- None.
